# Elite Dental Studio

> Elite Dental Studio is an ISO 9001 certified, specialist-led dental clinic group operating in Calicut (Kozhikode), Kochi, Kannur and Coimbatore. Founded in 2020 in Calicut, it offers implants, Invisalign and clear aligners, root canal treatment, laser dentistry, gum care, paediatric dentistry and more. Every case is handled by an MDS-qualified specialist trained in that exact field, and diagnosis (X-ray and full mouth examination) comes before any treatment quote. The group has received the Famdent Excellence in Dentistry Award.

Key facts:
- Clinics: Calicut, Kochi, Kannur, Coimbatore (Kerala and Tamil Nadu, India)
- Operating since 2020; all clinics ISO 9001 certified and Famdent recognised
- Specialties covered: implantology, orthodontics, pedodontics, endodontics, periodontics, prosthodontics, oral medicine and radiology, oral and maxillofacial surgery, restorative and cosmetic dentistry
- Approach: "We diagnose before we treat" and "one specialist, one field, every time"
- Payment: Bajaj and Zest No Cost EMI accepted on treatments
- Emergency dental care available for severe pain, swelling, broken tooth or sudden bleeding

## Treatments

- [All Services](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service): Overview of every dental specialty offered
- [Dental Implants](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/dental-implant): Replacement of single teeth or full arches
- [Invisible Aligners](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/invisible-aligners): Invisalign clear removable aligners
- [Clear Aligners / Braces](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/clear-aligners-treatment): Orthodontic treatment for crooked, crowded or gapped teeth
- [Clear Aligners](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/clear-aligners): Metal-free alignment option
- [Root Canal Treatment (Endodontics)](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/endodontics): Removal of infected tissue to save the tooth
- [Laser Dentistry](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/laser-dentistry): Laser procedures for gum and soft tissue conditions
- [Gum Treatment](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/gum-treatement): Care for bleeding, swollen or receding gums
- [Periodontics / Advanced Gum Treatments](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/periodontics): Deep cleaning and gum surgery
- [Dental Fillings](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/dental-fillings): Colour-matched tooth restoration
- [Dental Crowns / Restorative Dentistry](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/restorative-dentistry): Crowns, bridges and tooth rebuilding
- [Wisdom Teeth Removal / Orthognathic Surgery](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/maxillofacial-orthognathic-surgery): Oral and maxillofacial surgery
- [Paediatric Dentistry](https://elitedentalstudio.co.in/service/pediatric-dentistry): Dental care for children
